blocks.en:
Note that the graph is a subspace of $X\times Y$.

The following lemma is a direct consequence of the definitions of extensions and graphs of operators.
blocks.zh:
注意, 图是 $X\times Y$ 的子空间.

以下引理是算子的扩张和图的定义的直接推论.

blocks.en: The operator $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)$ is an extension of $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ if and only if $\Gamma(\widetilde A)\supset\Gamma(A)$.
blocks.zh: 算子 $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)$ 是 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 的扩张, 当且仅当 $\Gamma(\widetilde A)\supset\Gamma(A)$.
blocks.label: lem:operator-extension-graph-inclusion

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof is left to the reader.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We say that an operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is \textbf{closed} if its graph is closed as a subset of $X\times Y$. We call $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ \textbf{closable} if it has a closed extension. Every closable operator has a smallest closed extension which we call its \textbf{closure} and denote by $(\overline{\mathcal{D}(A)},\overline A)$.
blocks.zh: 若算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 的图作为 $X\times Y$ 的子集是闭的, 则称该算子是\textbf{闭的}. 若 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 有闭扩张, 则称它是\textbf{可闭的}. 每个可闭算子都有一个最小闭扩张, 称为它的\textbf{闭包}, 记为 $(\overline{\mathcal{D}(A)},\overline A)$.
blocks.label: def:closed-closable-operator-and-closure

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: It is useful to supplement this definition with a ``sequential'' notion of a closed operator. For instance, the following lemma is a direct consequence of the definitions of a closed operator and a closed set in a product space.
blocks.zh: 用闭算子的 ``序列'' 概念来补充这一定义是有用的. 例如, 以下引理是闭算子以及乘积空间中闭集的定义的直接推论.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: An operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is closed if and only if it has the following property. Whenever there is a sequence $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ such that\begin{enumerate}\item $x_n\to x$ and\item $Ax_n\to f$,\end{enumerate}then\begin{enumerate}\item $x\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ and\item $Ax=f$.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 是闭的, 当且仅当它具有以下性质. 只要存在序列 $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ 满足\begin{enumerate}\item $x_n\to x$, 且\item $Ax_n\to f$,\end{enumerate}就有\begin{enumerate}\item $x\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, 且\item $Ax=f$.\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: lem:closed-operator-sequential-criterion

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We have a similar characterization of a closable operator.
blocks.zh: 对于可闭算子, 有类似的刻画.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: An operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is closable if for every sequence $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ such that $x_n\to0$, we have either\begin{enumerate}\item $Ax_n\to0$, or\item $\lim_{n\to\infty}Ax_n$ does not exist.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 若对于每个满足 $x_n\to0$ 的序列 $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, 均有以下两者之一:\begin{enumerate}\item $Ax_n\to0$, 或者\item $\lim_{n\to\infty}Ax_n$ 不存在.\end{enumerate}则算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 可闭.
blocks.label: lem:closable-operator-zero-sequence-criterion

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: To prove this we construct a closed extension $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)$ of $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ as follows. If $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ is a sequence such that\begin{enumerate}\item $x_n\to x$ and\item $Ax_n\to f$,\end{enumerate}for some $f\in Y$, then we let\begin{enumerate}\item $x\in\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A)$ and define\item $\widetilde Ax=f$.\end{enumerate}We need to assure ourselves that $\widetilde Ax$ is unambiguously defined. However, our hypothesis assures us that if there is another sequence $\widehat x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ and $\widehat x_n\to x$, then either\begin{enumerate}\item $A\widehat x_n\to f$, or\item $\lim_{n\to\infty}A\widehat x_n$ does not exist\end{enumerate}(since $x_n-\widehat x_n\to0$). The operator $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)$ is closed by Lemma~\ref{lem:closed-operator-sequential-criterion}, and it was constructed to be an extension of $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$.
blocks.zh: 为证明这一点, 如下构造 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 的闭扩张 $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)$. 若 $x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ 是满足以下条件的序列:\begin{enumerate}\item $x_n\to x$, 且\item $Ax_n\to f$,\end{enumerate}其中 $f\in Y$, 则令\begin{enumerate}\item $x\in\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A)$, 并定义\item $\widetilde Ax=f$.\end{enumerate}需要确保 $\widetilde Ax$ 的定义没有歧义. 然而, 假设保证, 若另有序列 $\widehat x_n\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ 且 $\widehat x_n\to x$, 则有以下两者之一:\begin{enumerate}\item $A\widehat x_n\to f$, 或者\item $\lim_{n\to\infty}A\widehat x_n$ 不存在\end{enumerate}(因为 $x_n-\widehat x_n\to0$). 根据 Lemma~\ref{lem:closed-operator-sequential-criterion}, 算子 $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)$ 是闭的, 而且按其构造, 它是 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 的扩张.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In fact, it is easy to see that $\Gamma(\widetilde A)=\overline{\Gamma(A)}$. Thus, since $\overline{\Gamma(A)}\subset\Gamma(\overline A)$ (this follows directly from Definition~\ref{def:closed-closable-operator-and-closure}), and since the closure is defined to be the smallest possible extension, our construction actually yields the closure; i.e., $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)=(\overline{\mathcal{D}(A)},\overline A)$. In fact, we have shown the following.
blocks.zh: 事实上, 容易看出 $\Gamma(\widetilde A)=\overline{\Gamma(A)}$. 因此, 由于 $\overline{\Gamma(A)}\subset\Gamma(\overline A)$ (这直接来自 Definition~\ref{def:closed-closable-operator-and-closure}), 而且闭包按定义是尽可能小的扩张, 上述构造实际上给出了闭包; 即 $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)=(\overline{\mathcal{D}(A)},\overline A)$. 事实上, 已经证明以下结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.zh: 若 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 可闭, 则 $\Gamma(\overline A)=\overline{\Gamma(A)}$.
blocks.label: cor:closure-graph-is-graph-closure
